messages.content: The crash is in `priorityName`, which indexes `priorityNames[p-1]`. A stored priority of -1 gives index -2. The only writer is `createReminder`, which rejects priorities above 3 but never rejects values below 1. I'll write a reproducer that sends a negative priority.
